name: Bank Shot
description:
When you attack with your orb, you may bounce it off a flat surface as part of its trajectory. The total distance it travels for the attack must still be within its range.

If the target of the attack is a creature that you can see, you may roll Dexterity vs Dexterity against it, landing a normal hit on a win.

Describe your bank shot.

improvements.name: Play!
improvements.description: You may instead attempt to bounce your orb off of one creature before hitting a second creature. Roll Dexterity vs Dexterity against the first creature. On two wins, you land a normal hit on both creatures. If the first creature wins, you miss both. If you win against the first but lose against the second, you only land a hit against the first.
